sensitivePatterns.description: Magnetic-stripe track 1 data (start sentinel, format code B, account number, name, expiry and service code). Sensitive authentication data that must never be stored (PCI DSS 3.3.1.1). A parser test that needs a documented synthetic track can allow this pattern id through harness.secretsAllow in .specify/sdd-speckit.json.

Magnetic-stripe track 2 data (start sentinel, account number, separator, expiry, service code, discretionary data, end sentinel). Sensitive authentication data that must never be stored (PCI DSS 3.3.1.1). A parser test that needs a documented synthetic track can allow this pattern id through harness.secretsAllow in .specify/sdd-speckit.json.
